overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Administrative Policy Committee was scheduled to meet to address fiscal planning and property valuation matters, including a revaluation process update, preliminary equalized valuation figures, budget status reports, debt obligations review, and consideration of the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget.

agenda.item: Approval of July 21, 2026 Administrative Policy Committee Meeting Minutes
2026-2027 Revaluation Process Update from Village Assessor
Finance Director Report - 2026 Preliminary Equalized Valuation & TID Increments
Review of Existing Debt Obligations Outstanding

discussions.item: 2026-2027 Revaluation Process Update from Village Assessor
discussions.body: The Village Assessor was scheduled to present an update on the 2026-2027 property revaluation process. This report was expected to inform the committee on the status and progress of the village's property assessment revaluation efforts.

discussions.item: Finance Director Report - 2026 Preliminary Equalized Valuation & TID Increments
discussions.body: The Finance Director was set to report on the preliminary equalized valuation for 2026 and Tax Increment District (TID) increment figures. This report was expected to provide financial data relevant to the village's tax base and TID performance.

The committee was scheduled to review the budget status report for July 2026. This report was expected to detail the village's financial performance and expenditures through the first month of the fiscal year.

discussions.item: Review of Existing Debt Obligations Outstanding
discussions.body: The committee was set to review the village's existing outstanding debt obligations. This discussion was expected to provide an overview of the municipality's debt position and outstanding financial commitments.

The committee was scheduled to consider the 10-year Capital Improvements Program budget for 2027-2036. This was expected to be a significant agenda item involving discussion and possible action on the village's long-term capital planning and funding.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, with a 15-minute total period and three-minute individual time limit per person, with potential extension at the discretion of the Chief Presiding Officer.
